shape: 3-portal split arena (S+W+E gates) with west hub + central bridge + east clique
description: Three-portal arena split into a west cluster, a central bridge, and an east clique. The WEST cluster (83oy60) is a 4-way hub joining south_entry (kbjfy3), west_entry (wvnuag), the SW pocket chain (bh08ji → 2fd75b), and the center bridge (uoh291). The CENTER (uoh291) is the only connector between west and east halves. The EAST clique (9qaowd + 9u3qhk + ponnj7) is densely interconnected; ponnj7 also handles the east gate and the north corridor (1zu0ry → eaq2oy). One single-degree pocket (25lh0l) hangs off 9qaowd.

portals.south: spawn_south at (-13.36, 9.89) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, west column
portals.east: spawn_east at (22.97, 5.45) — gate on the east (high-X) side
portals.west: spawn_west at (-23.39, -2.77) — gate on the west (low-X) side

anchors.description: east entry hub - east clique anchor (matches ponnj7)

traversalNotes: Direct south ↔ east: spawn_south → south_inner → west_hub → center → east_hub → east_inner → spawn_east. 6 hops via the center bridge.
Direct south ↔ west: spawn_south → south_inner → west_inner → spawn_west. 3 hops (south_inner is wired to both gate inners).
Direct west ↔ east: spawn_west → west_inner → west_hub → center → east_hub → east_inner → spawn_east. 6 hops.
DISPATCH RULE: west_hub and east_hub are the cluster dispatchers; center is the only west↔east bridge.
SW pocket chain (sw_pocket_a → sw_corner) and N pocket chain (ne_corner → n_corner) are strict 2-hop dead-ends.
se_pocket (25lh0l) is a single-degree pocket off east_hub.
